sections.title: Unit 28: Railways, Motorways and Public Transport Policy, 2010–2026
body: This unit follows Hungarian transport policy from 2010 to the spring of 2026 as a finished period. Five accounts cover the state railway company MÁV, the branch lines, the motorway concession, the Budapest–Belgrade railway and the fare passes.
Each judgement in the texts has a source: the critics, the government's reasoning, an expert. Where a matter was disputed, the other side is named too.
